verdict.rationale: ROS 2's launch system lets you coordinate and start many nodes at once, and its CLI/introspection framework can operate across the whole graph (nodes, topics, services), which gives a loose analog to bulk operations, but there's no dedicated batch/bulk API (e.g., batch topic remap, bulk parameter set across nodes, mass import/export) described in the docs. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation tooling (e.g., scripted mass parameter updates, bulk topic/service operations), any evidence of an AI-native workflow performing such operations, and independent confirmation of this use case.
